name: The Witcher 3: Enhanced Edition - Redux
summary: The Witcher 3 Enhanced Edition is a total overhaul mod for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. It aims to enhance the game's experience by revamping combat, alchemy, economy, character progression and other mechanics. It introduces changes to make the game more challenging and realistic.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Free Next-Gen Update
summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Free Next-Gen Update was released on December 14, 2022, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. This update introduced graphical enhancements such as ray tracing, improved textures, and faster loading times, along with quality-of-life features like a new camera angle, revised UI, and integrated mods. It also added new content inspired by the Netflix series, including armor sets and a themed quest.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
summary:
Songs of the Past is a brand-new full-fledged expansion to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, one of the most acclaimed role-playing games of all time.

Created in partnership with Fool’s Theory, a team comprising veteran The Witcher 3 developers, players can once again take on the role of Geralt of Rivia and embark on a brand-new adventure before heading out on the Path as Ciri in the upcoming The Witcher 4.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine
summary:
Blood and Wine is the second major expansion to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt.

The players will accompany Geralt of Rivia to the region of Toussaint, one of the few places in the Witcher universe which has remained largely untouched by the war. The calm, laid-back atmosphere holds a dark and bloody secret that only the White Wolf can uncover; the expansion features new items for players to collect on their adventure and introduces previously unknown characters.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Contract: Skellige's Most Wanted'
summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest 'Contract: Skellige's Most Wanted' is a free DLC quest released in June 2015. It adds a new Witcher contract set on the Skellige Isles, where Geralt is hired to track down a dangerous creature responsible for attacking travelers.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition
summary:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Complete Edition is a comprehensive release that includes the base game, both major expansions (Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine), and all free DLCs. It has been issued in multiple versions over time:

- 2016 (PC, PS4, Xbox One): Released alongside the Game of the Year Edition, functionally identical but branded differently depending on region.

- 2022 (PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC): Updated version including the next-gen enhancements, such as ray tracing, visual upgrades, and quality-of-life improvements, plus additional content inspired by the Netflix series.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Contract: Missing Miners'
summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest 'Contract: Missing Miners' is a free DLC quest released by CD Projekt Red in May 2015. In this contract, Geralt investigates the disappearance of miners near the village of Blandare in Skellige.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered
summary:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered modernizes the acclaimed role-playing game with a range of upgrades and enhancements. Become monster slayer for hire Geralt of Rivia and journey across a dark fantasy open world in an epic quest to find your adopted daughter Ciri.

The Remastered update is free for players who own The Witcher 3 and includes both Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Where the Cat and Wolf Play...'
summary:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest "Where the Cat and Wolf Play..." is a free DLC quest released in July 2015. In this quest, Geralt investigates a village whose inhabitants have been mysteriously killed. The story centers on a confrontation with a Witcher from the School of the Cat and introduces choices that affect the outcome of the mission.

It adds a new standalone side quest with unique dialogue, a new location, and narrative ties to the broader Witcher lore.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Game of the Year Edition
summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Game of the Year Edition is a complete version of the game released in August 2016 for PC, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One. It includes the base game along with all post-launch content, including the two major expansions, Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine, and all free DLCs.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Fool's Gold'
summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest 'Fool's Gold' is a free DLC quest released by CD Projekt Red on June 3, 2015. In this humorous side quest, Geralt teams up with a character named Hystian to investigate a seemingly cursed village inhabited by pigs.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest: Scavenger Hunt: Wolf School Gear
summary: Adventure awaits! Embark on an epic treasure hunt and get your hands on a long-lost elite set of Wolf School witcher gear!

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone
summary:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Hearts of Stone is the first major expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, released in October 2015. It adds a new storyline set in the existing game world, where Geralt is hired to deal with Olgierd von Everec, a nobleman with a mysterious and cursed past.

The expansion introduces new characters, quests, enemies, and the Runewords system, which enhances gear with powerful effects. It emphasises narrative depth and moral choices, consistent with the tone of the main game.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Collector's Edition
summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Collector's Edition includes the game, an exclusive CD with the official soundtrack, the official developer-created Witcher Universe: The Compendium, a detailed map of the in-game world, a set of unique The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt stickers, a 33 x 24 x 25 cm hand-painted Polystone figure of Geralt of Rivia battling a Griffin, an exclusive collector-grade Witcher medallion, a SteelBook, a 200-page artbook containing art from the game, and outer and inner collector's boxes in which players can store their The Witcher merchandise.
